text:
asher: Kicking off canary for release/2026-03-23 — routing 4% to the new runtime for embeddings and chat. Change window 08:00-12:00 PT. Ill watch SLOs for 15m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-23

deploy-bot: Canary started job=canary-2026-03-23-4pct target=embeddings+chat routing=4% :rocket:

nina: SLO dashboard shows embeddings.p95 up to ~520ms at 1717702500 (baseline 230ms). Error rate small but trending: 0.09% -> 0.35% over 3m. link: https://obs.redwood/dashboards/slo/embeds-route

asher: Any recent config diffs?

deploy-bot: Config diff: increased kv-cache TTL from 60s -> 120s and enabled a new batcher heuristic flag `aggressive_prefill=true` on canary nodes. Diff: https://ci.redwood/config-diffs/2026-03-23

sre-oncall: Traces show worker timeouts with grpc: "deadline exceeded" and some 429s from internal rate limiter. Might be batcher producing larger requests upstream.

nina: That aligns: bigger batches -> longer single-call latency and occasional upstream backpressure. Recommend pausing canary and reverting aggressive_prefill flag for canary pool.

asher: Agreed. Pause first to stop impact. Then apply patch to set `aggressive_prefill=false` and run a synthetic probe.

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Routing 0% for canary-2026-03-23-4pct. Traces sampling increased.

asher: Patch: set service.batcher.aggressive_prefill = "false" in canary config.

deploy-bot: Config update applied config-change-1717702525. Starting synthetic probe job=synthetic-probe-1717702530 at 8 rps for 90s. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-03-23/1717702535

nina: Synthetic shows p95 back to ~240ms, error ~0.01%, no timeouts in traces. Good.

sre-oncall: Proposed plan: resume to 1% for 10m. If error_rate <0.15% and p95 <400ms, ramp to 8% then continue. If either metric breaches, execute rollback. I'll set alert thresholds: error_rate>0.5% OR p95>600ms => page+rollback.

asher: Resuming to 1% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-03-23-4pct target=1% (requested by asher)

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 1%. Observability sampling HIGH, alert window 5m.

pm-chris: Adding note for release notes: "Mitigation: disabled aggressive_prefill batcher flag for canary after p95 and timeout spike; will add regression test for batch size/backpressure."

nina: Also adding to postmortem: ensure kv-cache TTL change coupled with batcher heuristics is tested in integration tests.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor for the next 15m and stand by to rollback if needed: `deploy-bot rollback canary-2026-03-23 --full`.

asher: Thanks all. Marking ticket REL-2026-03-23 as PAUSED->PATCHED->RESUMED(1%). Will update with final status after the window. :thumbsup:
